locality_mapping_required: Map each sampled locality to mainland/ardens/no-Bombus only after inspecting the source locality table.
current_status: 2026-08-08 source audit: primary/CiNii abstract verified and Springer PDF/full-text routes identified; automated retrieval does not expose the population table. Abstract supports smaller Izu corollas and a gradual mainland-distance decline, not numeric effects.
